data.one_liner: Provides in-app Picture-in-Picture support with customizable widget
data.what_it_does: This package lets you start a PiP window inside a Flutter app, with options for navigation, resizing, moving, and custom borders. It replaces the standard MaterialApp with PiPMaterialApp to manage PiP state.
use_when: You need Picture-in-Picture functionality in a Flutter app
You want navigation inside the PiP window
You need to customize PiP size, position, or borders
You want to control PiP lifecycle events
avoid_when: You are building a web-only app that does not support PiP
You already have a custom PiP implementation that handles all required features
strengths: Highly customizable size, position, and appearance
Stable across Android, iOS, web, and desktop
weaknesses: No support for native platform-specific PiP APIs beyond Flutter
data.setup_notes: Replace MaterialApp with PiPMaterialApp or PiPMaterialApp.router and call PictureInPicture.startPiP(pipWidget: YourWidget());
